Seating upholstery: start with the union of (abs(x)<0.155, -0.035<y<0.175, -0.085<z<0.018) for the horizontal pad, and (abs(x)<0.105, -0.040<y<0.040, -0.010<z<0.255) for the upright pad. Seed the exposed horizontal broad face near (0,0.085,-0.035) and upright broad face near (0,0.005,0.13). Grow across native connected pad faces, including side and underside thickness faces, stopping at geometric cushion edges/support contact and creases against the metal seat pan, cargo floor, tubular guards or rack. Use obs01_requested_1 and both side projections to distinguish the rounded pad boundary from adjacent tubes; a UV seam is not a stop. Resolve any overlapping seed domains by native face connectivity and the visible pad boundary, not by filling either box. The two visible seating surfaces share one soft-region identity with no articulation. Build a connected volume only where the native pad geometry supports continuity; separated pad components remain disconnected components of the same flex domain and are independently supported, with no invented material bridge.
selection.reason: Rounded horizontal pad and narrow upright padded surface need compliant treatment; rail and pan remain support.

young_modulus.reason: Editable effective upholstered-padding prior; protective covering versus foam layers is unresolved.

probe_travel.reason: Initial indentation travel on each pad; measured deformation required.

recovery_residual_ratio.reason: Maximum recovered displacement divided by peak after support-rigid-motion subtraction.

soft_regions.reason: Input has wrinkles and padded thickness; native oblique view retains horizontal and upright cushioning. One semantic flex region covers both without inventing a reclining hinge.

native_scale.reason: Uniform metres per native arbitrary coordinate unit. Editable unmeasured scale prior yielding approximately 2.65 m length and 2.13 m height.

world_offset.reason: Derived placement for the chosen scale: lowest native point 0.04 m above demo ground; reference fixture supports the asset.

surface_friction.reason: Editable dry-contact friction prior; no source measurement.

interactions.name: front_rotation
interactions.action: With contact probe withdrawn, run real MuJoCo neutral -> negative endpoint -> positive endpoint -> neutral, one wheel at a time; hold other joints. Bind tire rim boundary to its hub and render flex states throughout.
interactions.expected: Measure hinge tracking <=0.0872664626 rad over FINAL reachable limits, visible relative wheel/support displacement >=0.01 metric asset diagonal, maintained tire/rim attachment, finite states and actual visible sweep penetration <=0.005 diagonal. Then include a combined low-speed wheel phase. Axle-bearing contact is explicitly scoped only at its attachment.

interactions.name: front_indentation
interactions.action: At neutral held hub angle, bring a real spherical mocap probe radially into the exposed lower/front tread sector from free space, ramp contact travel, hold, unload fully and allow recovery; zero other joint commands. Use a sector clear of fender and chassis.
interactions.expected: Archive actual contact force, peak nonrigid displacement after subtracting hub pose, strain and post-release residual. Peak must exceed 0.001 m and ten times unloaded numerical jitter; residual <=0.2 peak. No rigid hub displacement may be counted as compliance. Verify all native skin vertices bind with nonnegative weights summing to one and rest error <=0.001 diagonal. No seam detachment, inversion or large visible crossing.

review_requirements: Provide stable source-face ownership and multiview colored overlays for support, three hubs, both side panels and all four soft regions. Every original triangle must have exactly one owner; zero rigid/soft duplicates or unassigned original faces. Prove stationary fork/fender/axle/brackets are excluded from wheel skins, both sidewalls belong to their tire, pad thickness is covered, each panel carries its entire attached upper rail, and rear panel/tall rack/floor remain support. Preserve thin stalks/rails/controls and open entry, viewing aperture, cargo cavity and hub openings. Search-envelope inclusion alone is insufficient.

Verify original rest geometry, face UVs and PBR survive the common SI transform and body-local partition with zero removed or edited source area. Before each exposed_partition_caps addition, archive face-linked neutral/moved evidence showing the cut defect and the added narrow thickness/rim geometry. Total added area must be <=0.04 of native area. No broad replacement shell, glazing, cavity fill or concealed mechanism is authorized. Inspect newly exposed surfaces at the final panel endpoints.

Record scene/rest-frame transforms and approved child-local axes/pivots. In real mj_step phases, exercise front_spin, rear_minus_spin, rear_plus_spin, side_panel_minus_open and side_panel_plus_open separately and in the proposal's combined phases over FINAL DECLARED reachable ranges, returning to native neutral. Each moving visible assembly must displace >=0.01 metric asset diagonal relative to support and track endpoint angle within 0.08726646259971647 rad. Show hub/tire bead attachment, axle-center attachment and coherent panel/rail motion; stationary support must not follow. Inspect front-wheel wobble and inboard stationary hardware explicitly. Invisible joint motion cannot pass.

Measure rest clearance and the entire sampled actual visible-geometry sweep, including both directions for wheel ranges and return motion, against relevant support, floor, fenders, rack, rear panel, other panels and wheels. Penetration must be <=0.005 metric asset diagonal, with no large visible crossing or broken attachment. Scope attachment seams and intentional compliant probe contact explicitly without blanket collision disabling. Test original limits first; if needed use frozen search_safe_range with at most two 2/3-from-neutral reductions and archive every trial. Apply adjusted_requirements and final intervals consistently to MJCF, actuators, targets, controls and labels while preserving accepted identity/digest. Full closure and original extremes are not required; retain finite/stable/real-motion and policy minimum-range obligations.

interactions.name: seating_load_recovery
interactions.action: Run separate real contact load/hold/unload/recovery tests on the exposed top of the horizontal pad (downward probe) and front of the upright pad (probe toward -Y). Anchor the pad base/rear contact patches to support; leave exposed surfaces free. Unloaded controls and wheel probes remain clear.
interactions.expected: Each pad subdomain must independently show measured nonrigid displacement >0.001 m and >10 times unloaded jitter, actual probe contact, residual <=0.2 peak after recovery, finite strain and maintained attachment. Measure native flex skin binding rest error <=0.001 diagonal, preserve PBR and verify loaded/recovered renders. One deforming pad cannot stand in for the other.

interactions.name: side_panel_minus_release
interactions.action: Declare latch released as a demo initial-condition convention; do not claim a simulated latch mechanism. Drive neutral -> outward final endpoint -> neutral, separately for each side, then together. Sample the entire visible geometry sweep against floor, rear panel, front rack, chassis, wheels and opposite panel.
interactions.expected: Measure independent panel motion and attached rail coherence over final reachable interval, >=0.01 diagonal visible displacement, angular endpoint error <=5 degrees, and penetration <=0.005 diagonal. Inspect rest clearance, end seams and any newly exposed interior; cap only reviewed exposed cut rims. Full horizontal opening or complete closure beyond native neutral is not required.

interactions.name: side_panel_plus_release

interactions.expected: Measure independent panel motion and attached rail coherence over final reachable interval, >=0.01 diagonal visible displacement, angular endpoint error <=5 degrees, and penetration <=0.005 diagonal. review_requirements: Provide stable source-face ownership and multiview colored overlays for support, three hubs, both side panels and all four soft regions. Every original triangle must have exactly one owner; zero rigid/soft duplicates or unassigned original faces. Prove stationary fork/fender/axle/brackets are excluded from wheel skins, both sidewalls belong to their tire, pad thickness is covered, each panel carries its entire attached upper rail, and rear panel/tall rack/floor remain support. Preserve thin stalks/rails/controls and open entry, viewing aperture, cargo cavity and hub openings. Search-envelope inclusion alone is insufficient.

Verify original rest geometry, face UVs and PBR survive the common SI transform and body-local partition with zero removed or edited source area. Before each exposed_partition_caps addition, archive face-linked neutral/moved evidence showing the cut defect and the added narrow thickness/rim geometry. Total added area must be <=0.04 of native area. No broad replacement shell, glazing, cavity fill or concealed mechanism is authorized. Inspect newly exposed surfaces at the final panel endpoints.

Record scene/rest-frame transforms and approved child-local axes/pivots. In real mj_step phases, exercise front_spin, rear_minus_spin, rear_plus_spin, side_panel_minus_open and side_panel_plus_open separately and in the proposal's combined phases over FINAL DECLARED reachable ranges, returning to native neutral. Each moving visible assembly must displace >=0.01 metric asset diagonal relative to support and track endpoint angle within 0.08726646259971647 rad. Show hub/tire bead attachment, axle-center attachment and coherent panel/rail motion; stationary support must not follow. Inspect front-wheel wobble and inboard stationary hardware explicitly. Invisible joint motion cannot pass.

Measure rest clearance and the entire sampled actual visible-geometry sweep, including both directions for wheel ranges and return motion, against relevant support, floor, fenders, rack, rear panel, other panels and wheels. Penetration must be <=0.005 metric asset diagonal, with no large visible crossing or broken attachment. Scope attachment seams and intentional compliant probe contact explicitly without blanket collision disabling. Test original limits first; if needed use frozen search_safe_range with at most two 2/3-from-neutral reductions and archive every trial. Apply adjusted_requirements and final intervals consistently to MJCF, actuators, targets, controls and labels while preserving accepted identity/digest. Full closure and original extremes are not required; retain finite/stable/real-motion and policy minimum-range obligations.

For front_tire, rear_minus_tire, rear_plus_tire and seating, provide dimension-3 flex elements, coverage/support maps and dedicated native skin bindings. Preserve annular holes and support both seating subdomains independently if disconnected; invent no bridge. Every skin vertex must have valid local indices and finite nonnegative weights summing to one, with maximum reconstructed rest error <=0.001 metric diagonal. Use containing tetrahedra, not negative extrapolation or clamped weights. Document bead/base/rear anchors and free loadable surfaces; no rigid duplicate skin. Verify the same weights and measured flex states drive rendered and playback surfaces.

Within the allowed host dynamics budget, measure separate load/hold/unload/recovery subtests for each of the three tires and both horizontal/upright seating subdomains. Archive actual probe contacts and forces, unloaded jitter, owner-pose-subtracted nonrigid peak displacement, strain and recovery time series. Each subtest must exceed 0.001 m nonrigid displacement and ten times unloaded jitter, then recover to residual <=0.2 of its peak after probe withdrawal. Maintain attachment, finite states and noninverted elements; rigid movement or one pad deforming cannot satisfy another region. Provide visible loaded/recovered evidence for every subtest, using phase-local checkpoints within the render endpoint budget.

Bind body/flex render poses to actual MuJoCo trajectory states and retain all required fixed gates, physics-attempt budgets and independent visual review. Document collision-proxy coverage and omissions without filling native cavities or bypassing parent/child clearance. Disclose metric scale/material priors, neural hidden-region provenance, mounted-demo scope, latch-release convention and effective reachable limits. Failure or preview status must remain explicit if any required motion, soft binding or measured physical response fails. Browser verification belongs to its later designated stage.
